headline: NYM @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 3.79 at SDP 3.91, with a projected total of 7.70. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYM: NYM moved +0.71 runs while SDP moved +0.46, changing the projected margin by +0.25 runs. The projected total climbed +1.17, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -18.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Nolan McLean has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Fernando Tatis Jr., Juan Soto, Carson Benge, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Sung-Mun Song, Vidal Bruján because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
